name: SFS Group AG
summary: SFS Group AG supplies precision components and assemblies, mechanical fastening systems, tools, and procurement solutions in Switzerland and internationally. It operates in three segments: Engineered Components, Fastening Systems, and Distribution & Logistics. The company offers airbag restraint systems; automation; brake systems; building technology; clip nuts; communication technology; components, assemblies, and complete devices; connections and reinforcements for timber construction; and domestic and kitchen appliances.
